description: Wires the three v3/v4 enrichment modules (temporal_stability_enrichment_v4.py, tool_description_safety_enrichment_v4.py, permission_scope_enrichment_v3.py) into signal_analyser_v2 pipeline. Diagnostic shows these signals have only 3 distinct values each — they exist but are not being consumed. Creates a wiring module that invokes compute_score() for all 5118 servers across all three enrichments and writes results to mcp_signal_enrichments. Uses write_service :8772 only. No direct duckdb. Exposes run() + if __name__ == '__main__': run(). Must call send_heartbeat every 60s.
